sentences.text: Welcome to the Rainbow Garden, home to dozens of colourful flower beds.
The Water Discovery Station is just past the stone path on your left.
The next show on the Wind Stage starts in a few minutes.
Meet your group at Cloud Square before heading home.
Dam Sen Cultural Park is in District 11 of Ho Chi Minh City.
Many visitors still call the city centre Saigon.
The garden is open from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m. every day.

sentences.text: Look for the sign that reads Vườn Cầu Vồng, which means Rainbow Garden.
Staff may greet you with xin chào, the Vietnamese hello.
Ready? Hold the handrail tightly — the ride is about to start!
Note: please do not run on the wooden bridge; walk slowly (especially when it is wet).

From Cloud Square, follow the covered walkway for about two hundred steps, cross a small bridge, and turn right at the round flower bed to reach the Rainbow Garden, where shaded benches let the whole family rest.
The Water Discovery Station explains the water cycle with a simple model: water evaporates into clouds, clouds bring rain, and rain flows back into the lake to start again.
Children under one metre twenty must ride with an accompanying adult.
If you get lost, go to the nearest information desk and tell a staff member in a green shirt.
